user.title: PSA Car controller
user.description: Enter your psa_car_controller server, vehicle identity, and display name fields.

data_description.host: Example: http://192.168.0.100:5000 (scheme, IP or hostname, and port of psa_car_controller)
data_description.vin: Vehicle identification number: check psa_car_controller logs or config (e.g. cars.json), or your manufacturer app / vehicle documents
data_description.brand: Manufacturer name shown in Home Assistant, for example Peugeot or Citroën
data_description.model: Model name shown in Home Assistant, for example e-208
data_description.vehicle_image_url: Public HTTPS image URL (e.g. Peugeot V3DImage); saved as a centered 400×400 PNG with transparent padding under www/

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to PSA Controller. Check the host and VIN.
error.invalid_host: Enter a valid host, for example http://192.168.0.100:5000.
error.invalid_image_url: Enter a valid http(s) image URL or leave empty.
